rows.text: Planet Nikota has complex and solemn funeral traditions. Residents hold grand ceremonies for the deceased, and the government has laws prohibiting the desecration of tombstones. As time passed, the planet gradually became occupied by tombstones, leaving less and less living space for the living. Masked Fool Urima lived on Nikota for 40 years, attending thousands of funerals where guests would weep endlessly, with no hint of joy. So he planned a special funeral for himself: in front of everyone, his tombstone sprouted thrusters and soared into the sky to pounding beats, the exhaust flames burning an epitaph into the grass: "Come on, smile! Isn't it vast out there?"
